players.product: Area-laser bonding equipment (LSR laser selective reflow, LCB laser compression bonder) for advanced semiconductor packaging, which the company says can do HBM and interposer die bonding

quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 half-year report (DART, consolidated): H1 revenue KRW 3,255,291,206 (H1 2025: KRW 2,146,223,978); Q2 revenue KRW 2,061,285,502 (Q2 2025: KRW 984,202,591); H1 operating loss KRW 2,756,006,711 (H1 2025: loss KRW 6,602,539,205); Q2 operating loss KRW 1,050,574,196; H1 net loss KRW 5,323,812,736. Business-section revenue (KRW million): 2,935, of which overseas 2,784 (95%) and domestic 151 (5%). Top 3 customers (undisclosed, under NDA) took KRW 2,711 million, 92.36% of revenue; two customers above 10% of revenue accounted for KRW 2,570,683,000.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 revenue KRW 3,255,291,206 (H1 2025 KRW 2,146,223,978); H1 operating loss KRW 2,756,006,711; overseas 95% of revenue

quarterly_data.signal: Order position as of the report filing date: total orders including carried-over orders KRW 12.6 billion, of which KRW 1.45 billion delivered in the period, leaving an order backlog of KRW 11.15 billion (details withheld as confidential).
quarterly_data.figure: Order backlog KRW 11.15 billion (orders KRW 12.6 billion)

quarterly_data.signal: Company positioning in the report: its main target market is the TC bonder market used for interposer die bonding and HBM bonding, whose adopters it lists as Samsung, SK Hynix and TSMC; it states its LCB and LSR can bond dies to interposer PCBs and can also do HBM bonding, with a bonding time it puts at 1/6 of a TC bonder (1-4 seconds per chip) at about half the equipment price, and says area-laser heating avoids the warpage of mass reflow on packages thinner than 60um. It says its equipment is in global mass-production lines of a global semiconductor foundry, a leading mobile-device maker and a leading EV battery maker, and holds laser debonding patents. It sizes its obtainable TC bonder market at 222.74 million dollars by 2027 with 19.9% growth.
quarterly_data.figure: Bonding 1-4 seconds per chip; TC bonder market USD 222.74 million by 2027 (company estimate)

Laserssel.why: Makes area-laser bonding equipment (LSR, LCB) for advanced semiconductor packaging that it pitches against TC bonders for HBM and interposer die bonding; HBM / advanced-packaging capex is its target market.
Laserssel.evidence: Laserssel Q2 FY2026 (08-14-2026) half-year report: the company's main products LCB and LSR can bond dies to interposer PCBs by laser and can also do HBM bonding; its target market is the TC bonder market used by Samsung, SK Hynix and TSMC.
